verdict.rationale: Cake documents a few fixed, built-in background automations. The vesting engine automates cliffs, schedules, milestones and pauses. Board sign-off and e-signing use automated flows. Once a registered agent is added, Cake automatically notifies them of issuances, transfers and conversions. These are preset domain behaviors, not general user-defined automations, and the AI/MCP integration is explicitly read-only, so it cannot act agentically. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder with custom triggers and actions, agentic or AI-driven background execution, scheduling controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
